segments.name: Medical Device Packaging
segments.description: Markets and distributes syringe products and related drug-delivery systems to hospitals, clinics, healthcare providers, and medical supply organizations.
segments.evidence: Medical Device: This segment is responsible for executing and managing the Company's medical device sales and distribution business.

segments.name: Digital Asset Treasury
segments.description: Manages the company's digital asset treasury, holding and staking SOL to generate yield and potential price appreciation.
segments.evidence: Digital Asset Treasury: This segment is responsible for executing and managing the Company's treasury platform.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from sales of syringe products to healthcare customers and from staking rewards on its SOL treasury holdings.
revenueModel.evidence: Profit generation is expected primarily through (i) potential price appreciation of SOL and (ii) protocol-native staking rewards, which are accrued in SOL.

changes.text: In 2025, the company moved from a single operating segment to two reportable segments, Medical Device Packaging and Digital Asset Treasury.
changes.evidence: During the year ended 2025, as a result of the previously mentioned treasury policy, management re-evaluated its segment reporting structure and determined that is now operates in two reportable segments other than its corporate activities.

changes.text: In 2025, the company sold its Hungarian subsidiary Safegard Medical Kft, which is reported as a discontinued operation.
